tagline: Turning discarded cotton textiles into bacterial-cellulose nanocrystal films that reproduce the iridescence of kingfisher feathers, so the Dian Cui craft needs no birds
tagline_zh: 把廢棄棉織品轉化為細菌纖維素奈米晶體薄膜，重現翠鳥羽毛的虹彩，讓點翠工藝不再需要鳥
summary: HUST-China built IRIS to resolve an ethical problem inside a Chinese intangible cultural heritage: Dian Cui, the court craft of inlaying kingfisher feathers into metal jewellery. Rather than finding another animal substitute, they went after the physics - keratin-and-air microstructures producing angle-dependent structural colour, with melanin absorbing stray light to raise saturation - and reproduced it by growing bacterial cellulose from discarded cotton textiles, converting it to cellulose nanocrystals and self-assembling those into an ordered photonic structure, layered with pigment-based functional layers. Their design philosophy, formed in dialogue with artisans and conservationists, is 'retain the aesthetic core while abandoning the outdated carrier'. They won the peer-voted iGEMers Prize, and the reasons are legible on the wiki: they hosted a regional forum for other teams modelled on the Jamboree itself, and co-produced open science-communication materials with multiple other teams rather than only publishing their own.
summary_zh: HUST-China 做 IRIS，是為了解決一項中國非物質文化遺產內部的倫理問題：點翠——把翠鳥羽毛鑲嵌進金屬首飾的宮廷工藝。他們沒有去找另一種動物替代品，而是直接追究背後的物理：角蛋白與空氣交錯的微結構產生隨角度變化的結構色，黑色素則吸收雜散光以提高飽和度。他們改以廢棄棉織品培養細菌纖維素，再轉化為纖維素奈米晶體，讓其自組裝成有序的光子結構，並疊上以色素為基礎的功能層，重現了這個效果。與工藝師和保育人士對話後形成的設計理念是「保留美學核心，捨棄過時的載體」。他們獲得由各隊互相投票選出的 iGEMers Prize，原因在 wiki 上看得很清楚：他們仿照 Jamboree 本身的形式為其他隊伍辦了一場區域論壇，也與多支隊伍共同製作開放的科學傳播材料，而不只是發表自己的東西。

dry.frameworks: A published 'Who / Why / What / How' stakeholder engagement matrix, offered explicitly as a reusable blueprint for ethical technology research, plus a value-system analysis with value-oriented task execution. Education is organised as a three-dimensional positioning matrix of audience age against outreach domain, so every activity occupies a named cell (for example 'community teenagers x synthetic biology x Dian Cui culture x ecological conservation') and gaps in coverage are visible. SDGs 4, 11 (target 11.4), 12, 15 and 17 (targets 17.16, 17.17) are mapped individually with the specific partner that delivers each.
dry.frameworks_zh: 團隊發布了一套「Who／Why／What／How」利害關係人互動矩陣，並明確定位為可供倫理性技術研究重複使用的藍圖，另有一套價值體系分析與以價值為導向的任務執行方法。教育工作則編排成一張三維定位矩陣，以受眾年齡對推廣領域交叉，每項活動都落在一個具名的格子裡（例如「社區青少年 x 合成生物學 x 點翠文化 x 生態保育」），覆蓋不足的空缺也因此一目了然。SDG 4、11（指標 11.4）、12、15 與 17（指標 17.16、17.17）逐項對應，並指明由哪個夥伴負責落實。
dry.dataviz: A three-dimensional positioning map of educational practices (audience age x outreach domains); survey-result charts of public preferences for Dian Cui inheritance and conservation approaches; molecular dynamics trajectory analyses with reported standard deviations.
dry.dataviz_zh: 一張教育實踐的三維定位圖（受眾年齡 x 推廣領域）；關於民眾對點翠傳承與保育方式偏好的調查結果圖表；以及附標準差的分子動力學軌跡分析。
dry.datascience: Public surveys run as design instruments with reported n and percentages: 257+ then more than 400 valid responses (409 valid samples cited for the product-form survey), showing 63% had heard of Dian Cui but only 4% claimed in-depth understanding, 54.1% preferred recreating Dian Cui with substitute materials, 74.08% supported using synthetic biology to reproduce the structural colour, and 61.5% of science information reaching respondents came through short-video channels. The key analytic conclusion reshaped the whole programme: 'the inheritance dilemma stems from a lack of science communication, not public indifference', which produced tiered rather than uniform outreach.
dry.datascience_zh: 民眾問卷被當成設計工具使用，並載明樣本數與百分比：先是 257 份以上、後來超過 400 份有效回覆（產品形式問卷引用 409 份有效樣本），顯示 63% 的人聽過點翠，但只有 4% 自認深入了解；54.1% 偏好以替代材料重現點翠；74.08% 支持用合成生物學重現這種結構色；而填答者接收到的科學資訊有 61.5% 來自短影音管道。最關鍵的分析結論重塑了整個計畫：「傳承困境源自科學傳播不足，而非民眾漠不關心」，因而產生分層而非一體適用的推廣設計。
dry.software: Molecular dynamics work on an engineered disulfide tether: the S38C/T101C pair was simulated across oxidised and reduced states sharing coordinates and differing only by the SSBOND entry, with pdb2gmx closing the specbond from a 4.0 A Cbeta-Cbeta start to S-S 2.027 A (100% of frames inside 0.18-0.22 nm); reduction released the C-terminal region (CTR-to-core centre-of-mass distance 1.39 +/- 0.05 to 2.41 +/- 0.70 nm, CTR RMSF up ~1.9x). In a six-chain 100 ns per state run the tether settled at 2.96 +/- 0.04 A, 45% beyond its unstrained length, with no frame inside the relaxed 1.95-2.15 A window, so the team explicitly reclassified it as an extended covalent tether rather than a textbook disulfide and modelled it as a deliberately softened harmonic SG-SG bond - a careful negative-result reinterpretation.
dry.software_zh: 針對一個人工設計的雙硫鍵繫鏈所做的分子動力學工作：S38C/T101C 這組突變在氧化與還原兩種狀態下模擬，兩者共用同一組座標，唯一差別是 SSBOND 這一行；pdb2gmx 把 specbond 從起始的 4.0 A Cbeta-Cbeta 距離收攏到 S-S 2.027 A（100% 的影格落在 0.18-0.22 nm 之內）；還原則釋放了 C 端區域（CTR 與核心的質心距離由 1.39 +/- 0.05 nm 增至 2.41 +/- 0.70 nm，CTR 的 RMSF 上升約 1.9 倍）。在六條鏈、每種狀態各 100 ns 的模擬中，繫鏈最終穩定在 2.96 +/- 0.04 A，比其無應變長度多出 45%，而且沒有任何一個影格落在鬆弛的 1.95-2.15 A 區間內，因此團隊明確把它重新歸類為一條被拉伸的共價繫鏈，而不是教科書上的雙硫鍵，並刻意以軟化的諧振 SG-SG 鍵來建模——這是對負面結果一次謹慎的重新解讀。
stack: low-cost custom environmental-control hardware for film casting
techniques: bacterial cellulose production from waste cotton textiles
cellulose nanocrystal self-assembly into ordered photonic films

good.publicEngagement: HUST-China's education programme is built as a matrix, not a list: a three-dimensional map of audience age against outreach domain, with each activity placed in a named cell so coverage and gaps are both visible. The analytical basis was their own survey work - more than 400 valid responses showing 63% had heard of Dian Cui but only 4% understood it in any depth - which produced the diagnosis that drove everything else: the heritage inheritance crisis is a science-communication failure, not public apathy, so outreach must be tiered rather than uniform. The youngest cell is remote-area online teaching: joining the HUST Graduate Teaching-Support Group in Long'an, Guangxi, they delivered online science classes to local primary-school students, using sharks as the narrative thread to explain a species' importance to marine ecosystem stability and how synthetic biology can produce substitute materials ('Microbial Superheroes: Protecting Sharks'). The most grassroots cell is the Huanyu Cup street outreach, 'Huanyu Together - Reviving the Ancient Craft - Guarding Kingfisher Vitality', run in three staged phases: a community street booth explaining Dian Cui heritage in age-appropriate language with physical replica samples and correcting misconceptions through quizzes and on-site Q&A; close-range handling of craft replicas followed by guided hands-on Dian Cui-style handcraft so children experienced 'listening, seeing and making'; and distribution of science handbooks and souvenirs to consolidate learning. This reached over a hundred community children free of charge and, in the team's own framing, broke the 'waiting for audiences' limitation of traditional lecturing and proved lightweight grassroots outreach is feasible. The 'Colorful Vacation' summer childcare class at the Zisong Yijing Huating neighbourhood in Wuhan deliberately opened three topics in one classroom - synthetic biology, Dian Cui culture and ecological conservation - using science-aesthetic integration and accessible metaphors, with feedback collected during the handcraft session feeding back into the design of activities for younger groups. For secondary students choosing their majors, team members ran an alma mater revisit programme over the winter vacation, delivering lectures at five schools: the First Affiliated High School of Central China Normal University, Zhengding High School in Hebei, Foshan No. 1 High School, Yali High School and Yongji County Experimental High School, covering synthetic biology basics, kingfisher conservation and competition-experience sharing as career guidance. On campus they ran outreach classes and science booths with IRIS culturally inspired creative products. Ecological education left the classroom entirely through joint birdwatching with the HUST Bird Association, explaining kingfisher habitat and wetland ecology in the field, alongside an agreement with the Wuhan Birdwatching Association (President Ming Liang) on data linkage and university-society outreach. Internationally, three rounds of overseas interviews plus cultural exchange in Singapore, the United Kingdom and France carried Chinese aesthetics and kingfisher conservation abroad, with an explicit stance against 'piling up fragmented Chinese symbols or catering to stereotyped Western imaginings of the East', and the narrative strategy drawn from those interviews was 'emotional connection first, transparent technology second'. The work most likely to explain the peer-voted iGEMers Prize is what they did for other teams. On 12 July 2026 HUST-China independently hosted the First Central-China iGEM Forum (CCiF) at the Qiming College Maker Space, deliberately replicating the structure of the international Jamboree - opening speeches, thematic keynotes, a LiveStage presentation block, judge comment sessions and poster-booth free communication - with 15 online and offline teams, invited iGEM senior consultants, former gold medallists and industry guests; 14 teams presented in sequence and received targeted commentary on experimental design, human practices arrangement and logical completeness, then moved to poster booths for peer feedback, and every attendee left with a certificate and themed souvenirs. They also attended Grand APiC, the first Asia-Pacific Synthetic Biology Youth Conference (16-19 August at Southern University of Science and Technology and the University of Hong Kong), joined NAU-CHINA's nationwide ICII (Into China, Into iGEM 2026) community initiative and explicitly borrowed ICII's community-construction logic when designing their own CCiF, and won a Gold Prize at SynBio Challenges 2026 - exchanging with more than ten teams including Jilin University, Wuhan University, Nanjing University and the University of Hong Kong. Three concrete co-productions followed. With Beijing University of Chemical Technology they co-created the science picture book 'Wukong Asks the Way: A Pilgrimage Through Biological Science', and separately contributed specialised content to BUCT's air-to-protein popular-science publication addressing public misconceptions about electro-biocatalytic protein production, jointly refining the argument that proteins made from CO2 and N2 are biologically derived rather than hazardous industrial chemicals and that purification and toxicological evaluation are mandatory before deployment; the text was reviewed by both teams and published on BUCT's wiki as a shared output. With JLU-FBH they joined 'Together with iGEM: Across Villages, From Myths to Facts', a community-driven myth-busting handbook where JLU-FBH acted as chief editor coordinating submissions from over 17 global iGEM teams; HUST-China independently wrote a complete entry debunking the pseudoscience claim that blackened silver ornaments can detect heavy-metal poisons, which after mutual review and format alignment was integrated into the collective handbook and released publicly as a shared anti-misinformation resource for student synthetic biology groups worldwide. Finally, and unusually, the team benchmarked itself against past Best Education winners and published six named next-iteration commitments, each crediting the team it learned from: establish pre/post classroom tests following GreatBay-SCIE's accuracy-based pre/post design; standardise and open-source the Huanyu Cup and childcare-class courses into reusable course packages following RWTH Aachen's open course model; build an online matrix of short videos, graphics and online classrooms to match the 61.5% short-video share found in their survey; turn picture books, handbooks and posters into continuously updated open resources; explore parent and family participation models following GreatBay-SCIE's parent workshops; and keep recording 'whom we asked, what we learned, and what we changed accordingly', writing education as a traceable decision log rather than a list of activities.
good.publicEngagement_zh: HUST-China 的教育計畫是以矩陣而非清單搭起來的：一張受眾年齡對推廣領域的三維地圖，每項活動都放進一個具名的格子，因此覆蓋到哪裡、哪裡還缺，都看得見。分析基礎是他們自己的問卷——超過 400 份有效回覆顯示 63% 聽過點翠，但只有 4% 有任何深度的了解——由此得出帶動其餘一切的診斷：非遺傳承的危機是科學傳播的失敗，不是民眾冷漠，所以推廣必須分層，不能一體適用。年齡最小的那一格是偏鄉線上教學：他們加入華中科技大學在廣西隆安的研究生支教團，為當地小學生上線上科學課，以鯊魚作為敘事主線，說明一個物種對海洋生態系穩定的重要性，以及合成生物學如何做出替代材料（「微生物超級英雄：保護鯊魚」）。最貼近基層的一格是「環宇杯」街頭推廣活動「環宇同行——重現古藝——守護翠鳥生機」，分三個階段進行：先在社區街頭設攤，用符合年齡的語言解釋點翠這項工藝，備有實體複製樣品，並透過問答與現場提問糾正錯誤認知；接著讓孩子近距離把玩工藝複製品，再帶他們動手做點翠風格的手工藝，完整經歷「聽、看、做」；最後發放科普手冊與紀念品以鞏固學習。這場活動免費觸及一百多位社區兒童，用團隊自己的說法，它打破了傳統講座「等觀眾上門」的限制，證明輕量級的基層推廣是可行的。在武漢紫松逸景華庭社區辦的「繽紛假期」暑期托管課，刻意在同一間教室裡同時打開三個主題——合成生物學、點翠文化與生態保育——以科學與美學結合的方式和易懂的比喻講述，手作環節蒐集到的回饋則回頭用於設計給更低年齡層的活動。針對正在選填科系的中學生，隊員利用寒假回母校宣講，在五所學校開講：華中師範大學第一附屬中學、河北正定中學、佛山市第一中學、雅禮中學與永吉縣實驗高中，內容涵蓋合成生物學基礎、翠鳥保育與競賽經驗分享，作為生涯輔導。在校內，他們開設推廣課程並設置科普攤位，搭配 IRIS 的文創產品。生態教育則完全走出教室：他們與校內觀鳥協會合辦賞鳥活動，在野外解說翠鳥棲地與濕地生態，並與武漢觀鳥協會（會長 Ming Liang）達成資料串連與校會合作推廣的協議。在國際面，三輪海外訪談加上在新加坡、英國與法國的文化交流，把中式美學與翠鳥保育帶到國外；他們也明確表態反對「堆砌零碎的中國符號，或迎合西方對東方的刻板想像」，而從這些訪談整理出的敘事策略是「先建立情感連結，再談透明的技術」。最能解釋他們為何能拿下各隊互投的 iGEMers Prize 的，是他們替其他隊伍做的事。2026 年 7 月 12 日，HUST-China 獨力在啟明學院創客空間舉辦第一屆華中 iGEM 論壇（CCiF），刻意複製國際 Jamboree 的架構——開幕致詞、主題演講、LiveStage 報告時段、評審評論環節與海報攤位自由交流——共有 15 支線上與線下隊伍參與，並邀請 iGEM 資深顧問、歷屆金獎隊伍成員與產業界來賓；14 支隊伍依序報告，針對實驗設計、人類實踐安排與邏輯完整性收到具體評論，之後移往海報攤位接受同儕回饋，所有參加者都領到證書與主題紀念品。他們也參加了第一屆亞太合成生物學青年大會 Grand APiC（8 月 16-19 日，在南方科技大學與香港大學舉行），加入 NAU-CHINA 發起的全國性社群計畫 ICII（Into China, Into iGEM 2026），並明白表示自己設計 CCiF 時借用了 ICII 的社群建構邏輯；他們還在 SynBio Challenges 2026 拿到金獎——過程中與吉林大學、武漢大學、南京大學與香港大學等十多支隊伍交流。接著是三項具體的共同產出。他們與北京化工大學共同創作科普繪本《悟空問路：生物科學取經記》，另外也為 BUCT 關於「空氣變蛋白」的科普出版物提供專業內容，處理民眾對電化學生物催化產製蛋白的誤解，並共同把論點打磨清楚：以 CO2 與 N2 製成的蛋白質來源是生物性的，而非危險的工業化學品，但在實際應用前必須完成純化與毒理評估；該文經兩隊互審後，刊在 BUCT 的 wiki 上作為共享產出。他們也與 JLU-FBH 一同參與「Together with iGEM: Across Villages, From Myths to Facts」——一本由社群驅動的破除迷思手冊，由 JLU-FBH 擔任主編，統整全球 17 支以上 iGEM 隊伍的投稿；HUST-China 獨立撰寫了一則完整條目，駁斥「銀飾變黑可以驗出重金屬毒物」這個偽科學說法，經互審與格式統一後併入這本集體手冊，並公開發布，成為全球學生合成生物學社群共用的反錯誤資訊資源。最後，也相當少見：團隊拿自己去對標歷屆 Best Education 得主，公布六項具名的下一輪改進承諾，每一項都註明是向哪支隊伍學來的：參考 GreatBay-SCIE 以正確率為基礎的前後測設計，建立課堂前後測；參考 RWTH Aachen 的開放課程模式，把環宇杯與托管班的課程標準化、開源成可重複使用的課程包；建立短影音、圖文與線上課堂的線上矩陣，以對應問卷中 61.5% 的短影音佔比；把繪本、手冊與海報轉為持續更新的開放資源；參考 GreatBay-SCIE 的家長工作坊，探索家長與家庭參與的模式；並持續記錄「我們問了誰、學到什麼、又因此改了什麼」，把教育寫成一份可追溯的決策紀錄，而不是一張活動清單。
good.ihp: Human Practices is described as the strategic engine and compass rather than a parallel track, and the evidence supports it. Early dialogue with Dian Cui artisans, cultural scholars and conservationists produced the zero-animal-harm ecological baseline and the design philosophy of retaining the aesthetic core while abandoning the outdated carrier. Expert consultation on the in vitro film-formation difficulty of reflectin triggered a decisive wet-lab pivot: the reflectin module was abandoned entirely for the fashion-waste-to-CNC route. Further expert feedback produced protein tag modifications for easier detection and optimisation of the BC-to-CNC conversion. Market research and public surveys redefined the product from a museum replica into mid-priced Bio-Fashion daily-wear jewellery, which in turn drove the team to design custom cost-conscious hardware for better environmental control during film casting. Stakeholder findings were specific: Teacher Liu Yang at Beijing 798's Slow Time Handicraft Workshop showed that peacock-feather imitations are too green and bright and crack and peel; the manager of the Guangzhou Yuequ Intangible Cultural Heritage Inheritance Institute explained that natural peacock feathers carry high loss and raw-material cost, that Dian Cui has high social-media popularity but far fewer offline experience visits than mother-of-pearl, that goose feathers and blue pattern paper cannot replicate the iridescence, and that a real Dian Cui sealing layer destroys the iridescence - a pain point that became the team's core engineering goal of reconciling film durability with structural-colour retention. Systematic museum benchmarking at the Palace Museum, Hong Kong Palace Museum, Zhenbao (Treasure) Museum and Hubei Provincial Museum set the optical performance target and informed film pitch and colour-gradient tuning; at the Hubei Provincial Museum the absence of genuine Dian Cui and the crudeness of the gift-shop imitations pushed them away from motif reproduction toward material reproduction. Government engagement produced a written reply from the Wuhan Bureau of Landscape Architecture and Forestry confirming Wuhan has no traditional Dian Cui manufacturers and no records of illegal hunting or trade, which deliberately shifted the team's narrative from 'solving current poaching' to 'preventing potential poaching risks' via positive biodiversity publicity; a dedicated symposium with the Wuhan Ecology and Environment Bureau on 10 September 2025 brought in solid-waste, ecological-protection and environmental-industry experts and standardised lab waste management and compliant waste-cellulose sourcing.
good.ihp_zh: 人類實踐被定位為整個專案的策略引擎與指南針，而不是一條平行的支線，而證據也支持這個說法。早期與點翠工藝師、文化學者與保育人士的對話，確立了零動物傷害的生態底線，以及「保留美學核心、捨棄過時載體」的設計理念。關於 reflectin 在體外難以成膜的專家諮詢，促成濕實驗的決定性轉向：reflectin 模組被完全放棄，改走「時尚廢棄物轉 CNC」的路線。後續的專家意見帶來蛋白質標籤的修改以方便偵測，也促成 BC 轉 CNC 流程的最佳化。市場調查與民眾問卷把產品從博物館複製品重新定義為中價位、可日常佩戴的 Bio-Fashion 首飾，這又促使團隊自行設計低成本硬體，以在薄膜製備時更好地控制環境條件。利害關係人的回饋很具體：北京 798 慢時光手作工坊的 Liu Yang 老師指出，孔雀羽毛做的仿品偏綠偏亮，而且會開裂、剝落；廣州 Yuequ 非物質文化遺產傳承院的負責人說明，天然孔雀羽毛的損耗與原料成本都高，點翠在社群媒體上熱度很高、但實際到店體驗的人數遠低於螺鈿，鵝毛與藍色花紋紙都無法重現那種虹彩，而真正的點翠封層會破壞虹彩——這個痛點後來成為團隊的核心工程目標：讓薄膜的耐久性與結構色的保留能夠兼得。他們也系統性地到故宮博物院、香港故宮文化博物館、珍寶館與湖北省博物館做實物對標，據此訂出光學表現目標，並調整薄膜的螺距與色彩漸層；在湖北省博物館，館內沒有真品點翠、紀念品店的仿品又相當粗糙，使他們從「重現紋樣」轉向「重現材料」。與政府部門的往來則取得武漢市園林和林業局的書面回覆，確認武漢沒有傳統點翠製造業者，也沒有非法獵捕或交易的紀錄，這讓團隊刻意把敘事從「解決當前的盜獵問題」轉為「透過正面的生物多樣性宣導，預防潛在的盜獵風險」；2025 年 9 月 10 日與武漢市生態環境局合辦的專題座談，請來固體廢棄物、生態保護與環保產業的專家，促成實驗室廢棄物管理的標準化，以及合規的廢棄纖維素來源管道。
good.realWorld: Four reusable outputs are named explicitly: the value-system analysis and value-oriented task execution framework; the documented Who/Why/What/How stakeholder engagement matrix as a blueprint for ethical technology research; open-source educational resources co-created with other teams; and low-cost hardware promoted so other teams and industry can fabricate structural-colour films more consistently on a limited budget. Market positioning was derived from field evidence: Wuhan SKP luxury retail (Louis Vuitton, Rolex) as the high end, the Tanhualin district in Wuhan and Chongqing cultural-creative markets as the affordable end, where the team found Dian Cui and imitation products essentially absent and most blue ornaments made from pigment, mother-of-pearl or spun thread - establishing the mid-tier sustainable jewellery gap IRIS targets.
good.realWorld_zh: 團隊明確列出四項可重複使用的產出：價值體系分析與以價值為導向的任務執行框架；已文件化的 Who/Why/What/How 利害關係人互動矩陣，作為倫理性技術研究的藍圖；與其他隊伍共同創作的開源教育資源；以及對外推廣的低成本硬體，讓其他隊伍與產業能在有限預算下更穩定地製作結構色薄膜。市場定位則是從田野證據推導出來的：高端對標武漢 SKP 的精品零售（Louis Vuitton、Rolex），平價端則看武漢曇華林一帶與重慶的文創市集，而團隊發現點翠與其仿品在那裡基本上不存在，多數藍色飾品是以色素、螺鈿或繞線製成——由此確立 IRIS 要切入的中價位永續首飾缺口。

gemsTakeaway: Earn peer goodwill by building infrastructure for other teams, not just audiences: HUST hosted a regional forum that replicated the Jamboree's own format (keynotes, LiveStage talks, judge commentary, poster walk) for 15 teams, then wrote entries into two other teams' open publications - and publicly benchmarked its own education against past Best Education winners with six named, credited improvements for next year.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 想贏得同儕的好感，就去為其他隊伍建基礎設施，而不只是對著觀眾做推廣：HUST 為 15 支隊伍辦了一場區域論壇，完整複製 Jamboree 自己的形式（主題演講、LiveStage 報告、評審評論、海報巡展），接著替另外兩支隊伍的開放出版物撰寫條目——而且還公開拿自己的教育工作去對標歷屆 Best Education 得主，列出六項具名、並註明向誰學習的明年改進事項。
